<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex11201_2026-02-1012-52-40" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon">dbu ma la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa slob dpob zla ba grags pa zab pa dang rgya che ba'i tshul gsal bar mdzad pa | theg pa mchog la thugs gzhol ba yi? phrogs pa'i mkhyen rabs dang thugs rje mnga' ba ri lor bris pa'i ba drus? bsal? 'o ma bzhos pas bden par zhen pa zlog par mdzad pas sbyar ba | rgya gar gyi mkhan po kyi SHNa paNDi ta dang bod kyi lo tstsha ba nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur zhing ? kyi rgya gar kyi mha? po ti la ka ka la sta dang | bod kyi lo tstsha ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis bsgyur ba ltar bshad pa | mang du thos pa'i tshun pa shes rab seng ges chen po dag gis bkas bskul ba bzhin | dpal snar thang gi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba dge'o || 
         </seg></TEI>
